text:
Marta (Hiring Manager): Heads-up: new Data PM (Ava) starts Wed. Can we make a "manager bridge" snippet I can paste into the welcome DM? Needs: pre-day ops, compact week-1 agenda, a 30/60/90 one-liner, 3 success signals, and a tiny delegation matrix (what manager approves vs escalates). Also confirm buddy + device.
Casey (People Ops): Drafting a manager-bridge below 14 copy/paste friendly. Edit as needed.
Ish (IT): I'll order laptop + trigger SSO. Marta: mac or windows? Shipping address DM pls.
Marta (Hiring Manager): DM sent. Mac preferred.
Jun (Buddy): Happy to buddy. I can do a 45-min product tour Wed morning and pair on the first ticket Thu.
Casey (People Ops): Manager bridge (paste into welcome DM):
```
PRE-DAY (to complete before start)
- Confirm device & shipping with IT; provide preferred OS and shipping address
- Create SSO/email invites and Slack account; add to team & #data calendar events
- Assign buddy and add short "who-to-ask" list to doc

WEEK 1 (compact)
- Day0: Welcome DM + HR forms, benefits link, quick Slack intro in #team
- Day1: 60-min product + data flows walkthrough (manager + buddy), repo/staging access check
- Day2: tiny first ticket (read -> write), pair with buddy to run CI + staging deploy
- Day3: stakeholder intros (20m per key partner), metrics & dashboards tour
- Day4: align on 30-day focus, schedule recurring 1:1s (weekly x8), share 30/60/90 draft
- EOW: manager posts 3 success signals & hands off initial backlog slice

30/60/90 (one-liners)
- 30d: complete onboarding checklist, run CI validation ticket, deliver a 1-page discovery note
- 60d: own a small backlog area, run one cross-team sync, merge independent PRs
- 90d: lead a scoped rollout that moves a target metric and maintain stakeholder cadence

DELEGATION MATRIX (example)
- Approve: day-to-day task priorities within agreed backlog slice
- Decide with manager: cross-team tradeoffs that affect roadmap or metrics >5%
- Escalate to director: major scope/OKR changes, budget requests, security exceptions

MANAGER DELIVERABLES (what manager must do)
- Confirm device & SaaS list pre-day; add buddy to doc
- Schedule weekly 1:1s for first 8 weeks and a 2-week feedback check
- Draft and publish 30/60/90 + 3 success signals by EOW
- Assign the tiny first ticket and approve first PR within week 2

WHO TO ASK (pasteable): repos -> Eng Lead (Sam), data infra -> Platform (team), dashboards -> Data Eng (Lee), deploys -> Devops
```
Marta (Hiring Manager): Clean. Can you add 3 short success signals per milestone? Want them explicit so managers can copy.
Casey (People Ops): Added quick signals (managers can tweak):
- 30d signals: completed CI/staging ticket, delivered discovery note, onboarding checklist complete + trainings acked
- 60d signals: >=3 merged PRs, led a sync with notes, owns a backlog board with priorities
- 90d signals: led release with measurable metric lift, stakeholder cadence established, handed off documentation for next steps
Ish (IT): Device ordered. ETA 3 business days. SSO invites queued. If MDM delays we'll provision a temporary cloud instance for immediate access.
Priya (HR): I'll include payroll & benefits enrollment link in Day0 DM. Also flag: security training and COI ack due within 5 business days.
onboard-bot: Reminder created: "Ava - Day0 welcome + IT prep" scheduled for 2024-07-01 09:00. :bell:
Jun (Buddy): Adding a tiny "first-ticket" idea: validate the nightly data pipeline run for one source, fix any failing test, and document the data lineage. Good for permissions + wins.
Marta (Hiring Manager): Love that. One more: can folks drop role-specific SaaS (Amplitude, Looker, Figma) here so IT can add them to the order?
Ish (IT): Add Amplitude + Looker for now. Figma later if required. I'll wait for final list before finalizing SaaS invites.
Casey (People Ops): Final steps for manager: (1) confirm calendar invites & buddy, (2) publish the 30/60/90 + success signals in the shared doc, (3) DM the new hire the one-page agenda by EOD Tues. I can help send the DM once device + SSO confirmed. :white_check_mark:
Marta (Hiring Manager): Done. Thanks everyone 14 will paste bridge into offer follow-up and #new-hires.
